pages.text: It follows you and stands in your defence. Left too far behind, it rises from the floor beside you. Sneak and touch it: it stays or comes. An Everfrost Crystal heals it.
Velkhar's smith forges a saddle for its back. From the saddle it stamps on $(k:key.frozen_dominion.monstrosity_stomp) (hold and let go), held to the full it charges, and it swings when you strike.
